title: Mapping whole-tissue spatial multi-omics at single-cell resolution with STEP
abstract: Spatial omics technologies have revolutionized our ability to map transcriptomic, proteomic, or metabolomic profiles within tissue contexts. However, existing spatial multi-omics approaches emphasize clustering or domain identification from measured profiles, while a general framework for whole-slice mapping in measured and unmeasured areas at single-cell resolution across additional omics layers remains lacking. Here we introduce STEP, a computational framework that integrates probabilistic inference with deep learning for flexible integration of histology, spatially resolved transcriptomics (SRT), single-cell, and/or multi-omics data. We validated STEP's advantages across diverse applications. Furthermore, STEP enables tri-modal integration of Xenium, CITE-seq, and imaging mass cytometry to map transcriptome-wide gene expression and protein profiles from a small gene panel. Through quadra-modal integration of SRT, histology, single-nucleus RNA sequencing, and inCITE-seq, STEP reconstructs a 3D multi-omics brain cell atlas from six low-resolution SRT sections. Collectively, STEP provides a cost-effective tool for exploring spatial biology by integrating diverse, complementary modalities.

llm.novelty_zh: 将概率推断与深度学习结合，实现跨组织切片已测与未测区域的单细胞分辨率全切片映射，并支持组织学、SRT、单细胞及多组学的灵活多模态整合。
llm.summary_zh: STEP 是一个整合概率推断与深度学习的计算框架，可灵活融合组织学图像、空间转录组（SRT）、单细胞和/或多组学数据。作者展示了其在 Xenium、CITE-seq 和 imaging mass cytometry 三模态整合中，由小基因panel 映射全转录组基因表达与蛋白谱的能力，并通过四模态整合从六张低分辨率 SRT 切片重建三维脑细胞多组学图谱。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把空间多组学从区域聚类推进到单细胞分辨率的全切片、跨模态映射，与“虚拟组织/细胞状态预测”方向相关。其低成本策略（小panel 推断全转录组与蛋白）对空间组学数据补全有实际参考价值。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未给出定量基准指标、与强基线的具体比较或可复现性信息，且研究聚焦空间插补/映射而非扰动预测或基础模型。
